scope: Edited native browser stills of two visibly separate modes: fresh synthetic same-book REP3 auction and recorded funded regtest settlement; not real-time proving

scenes.title: Try it. Then verify it.
scenes.caption:
Create and clear a fresh demo auction. Inspect a separate recorded settlement.
The two modes do not share tickets, funds or results.

scenes.title: Create your auction.
scenes.caption:
Set units, reserve, deposit budget and the real close time.
Demo funds; no native payment is made for this new auction.

scenes.title: Seal bids. Get signed acceptance.
scenes.caption:
Four actual input ZK proofs and 12 signed acceptances.
The localhost helper sees typed values; public acceptance contains no bid opening.

scenes.title: Close bidding. Lock the book.
scenes.body:
Four accepted tickets. The real deadline passes.
Three operators certify one closed book.
Clearing uses those exact secret shares.
The public proof must match this auction.
scenes.caption:
Edited time jump: the real cutoff was enforced.
Fresh root 086dc2a7...512cff is separate from the recorded settlement root.

scenes.title: Clear this auction. Open your own outcome.
scenes.caption:
This fresh book cleared with actual REP3 and C++ verification in 8.28s.
Price 43, sold 2. Own refund entitlement 57; no payment sent.

scenes.title: Now switch to recorded settlement.
scenes.body:
Switch to a DIFFERENT recorded auction.
Real regtest funds; exact native settlement.
The demo bids above have NOT been paid.
These receipts belong only to the recorded book.
scenes.caption:
The browser labels this switch explicitly.
One-host isolated regtest, not a live hosted or public-testnet auction.

scenes.title: The winner opens only their own receipt.
scenes.caption:
Fixed proofs and the signed book pass before the own viewing key is read.
Ticket 01 decrypts its native refund memo: won, refund 50 zatoshi.

scenes.title: A changed proof is rejected.
scenes.caption:
This screenshot follows an actual corrupted-proof check.
The fixed verifier rejects before reading the recipient key or decrypting.

scenes.title: Six shielded outputs. The same transaction.
scenes.caption:
Recorded public replay: 112.431 seconds; no private openings read.
Native authorization, six bindings, MPC, receipt proof and accepted book pass.

scenes.title: Funded, signed, confirmed on regtest.
scenes.body:
4 actual deposits -> one accepted book -> 6 outputs
2-of-3 DKG signing; no escrow master key reconstructed
Zebra acceptance + 2 controlled confirmations + exact wallet scans
Public proof validity and chain inclusion are separate checks.
scenes.caption:
The public bundle is 153,557 bytes. Trust admission keys separately.
Full funded recovery: 1847.653s on a shared 16GiB M1, one native thread.

scenes.title: Know what you are trusting.
scenes.body:
Bid privacy: at most 1 semi-honest corrupt REP3 party
Two colluders can reconstruct bids; two signers can move funds.
Operators learn refunds and winning status.
One host / regtest; no public-testnet or Linux speedup claim.
scenes.caption:
Source + public proofs + fixed replay command are ready for review.
Second-machine reproduction and independent operators remain unfinished.
